title: KP Core Ownership Convergence

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved 24-slice ownership tranche with an ordered bundle and application isolation deferral.

allowedWork: Architecture declarations, import analysis, and boundary gates.
Context-safe HTML-output ownership and renderer theme inversion.
Legacy public SDK reachability, retirement, or isolation with adjacent tests and diagnostic metadata.
Project memory, Theseus evidence, and exact compatibility retirement adjacent to migrated callers.
disallowedWork: Animation choreography, visual tuning, layout, new animations, or curriculum.
Place-value compositor work, catalogue pack splitting, CSS reorganization, or Vite consolidation.
Internal Studio or Public Web restructuring, SvelteKit adoption, or physical package extraction.
Mutation of current economics authoring source or generated publication.
goal: Enforce the framework-neutral KP dependency graph, remove known upward dependencies, and resolve the legacy public equation SDK without changing visible behavior.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and completed Theseus evidence; never stage protected economics files or unrelated user documents.
stopConditions: Stop if work would affect visible choreography or require aesthetic judgment.
Stop if an external production consumer prevents safe SDK retirement.
Stop if semantic IDs, sampled frames, endpoints, URLs, or current bundle ceilings change.
Stop if HTML trust contexts cannot be proven equivalent.
Stop if unrelated user work overlaps a required file.
Stop if bundle or application isolation work becomes necessary to close this ownership tranche.
Stop if a broad failure cannot be repaired inside the approved ownership boundary.

slices.title: prove-core-to-tutorial-neutrality
